title.cn: 离境口岸：真正的毕业闸
title.en: Exit Border: The Real Graduation Gate

text.cn: 你走向离境检查。护照、表情、行李轮子的声音都突然很清晰。这一站结束后，系统会根据你的金钱、精神与本地化判定：你到底是怎样离开中国的。
text.en: You walk to departure control. Passport, face, suitcase wheels — suddenly crisp. After this stop, money, sanity, and locality decide how you leave China.

feedback.cn: 盖章声很轻，结局很重。你回头看一眼——扫码、台阶、海风，都还在身后。
feedback.en: The stamp is soft; the ending is heavy. You glance back — QR codes, stairs, sea wind still behind you.

text.cn: 关口在你身后合上。旅途结算开始。
text.en: The gate closes behind you. Journey resolution begins.
